notes.title: Kaetram v2.3.3 - THE Update
notes.notes:
We've been working hard behind the scenes on the backend rewrite. In the meantime this update focuses primarily on balancing items and addressing some issues with crafting. No worries though, we have also included some new, much needed stuff.

- Added 50 new crafting recipes.
- Added little mazes in the Wastelands.
- Added new backslot equipment for archers.
- Added newly revised hides for crafted armors.
- Added soul altar in Wastelands that gives 2x exp.
- Added new chest character customization options.
- Added guaranteed feather drops to all feathered creatures.
- Added all craftable boots, quivers, chests, legs, and hoods.

- Fixed bowmaster quest.
- Fixed Iron recipes needing Aquasillius.
- Fixes inconsistencies with healing items.
- Fixed hide equipment issues when logging in.
- Fixed Strength/Accuracy Guides regarding Timeless Glaive.
- Fixed Horsing around quest requirements and text.

- Buffed the Lunar Dragons.
- Tweaks to prices of hides.
- Tweaks to rarities to make more sense.
- Reworked the in-app purchase interface.
- Changed early game crafting recipes.
- Changed gold bars to only require 1 coke coal.
- Changed Ibo exp rates and the coke coal requirement.
- Changed crafting gem arrowheads to reward less (15 -> 10)
- Changed metal arrowheads to reward more(20 -> 30)
- Changed Babushka timer from 1 minute to 30 seconds.
- Changed Babushka stock of cowhides from 1000 to 500.
- Changed trees to have increased depletion rates and bloodwood to have a higher difficulty


- Removed all unnecessary hides from mobs/tables.
